details:
This package contains a stub build-time helper, which in another package of the same uploader was already turned into a backdoor installation. While this package does not yet contain malicious code, it is clear it was uploaded with such intention and likely exploits dependency confusion.


---

Category: MALICIOUS - The campaign has clearly malicious intent, like infostealers.


Campaign: 2026-10-test-workalendar-internal


Reasons (based on the campaign):


 - backdoor


 - The package overrides the install command in setup.py to execute malicious code during installation.
